title: Oak Dormitory
shortDescription: Patchwork quilts and oak beams promise a sturdy night's sleep.
longDescription:
Broad bunks fit around an oak trunk that continues politely through the ceiling. Patchwork quilts turn each bed into a little country of its own, and paper acorns label the empty trunks.
A sock puppet presides over the common shelf. Rain taps the windows with the confidence of a visitor who knows there will be tea.

fixtures.name: Sock Puppet
fixtures.examineDescription: A knitted dragon wears a bottle-cap crown. Its stitched notice reads: 'Dormitory Keeper of Lost Things. Please return what you borrow. Especially my other sock.' A smaller note welcomes new Collegians to add a story, once they have one.
